name: Mahamarichyadi Taila (Oil)

sections.introduction: Mahamarichyadi Taila (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation. This is formulated from the mixture of many herbs. This formulation is known to contain properties like antifungal, antiseptic and antioxidant etc. This is usually used to treat problems related to skin.
sections.ingredients:
Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Nishoth – Operculina Turpethum 
 Dantimool – Baliospermum montanum’s root 
 Aak ka dudh – Calotropis gigantean plant’s milk 
 Gobar ka ras – Dung’s juice 
 Devdaaru – Cedrus deodara

 Kanerimool 
 Hartaal 
 Mainshil 
 Chitrakmool – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Kalihari – Gloriosa superba 
 Vidanga – Embelia ribes 
 Pavaar ke beej 
 Shirish ki chaal – Albizzia lebbek 
 Kutuj k chaal – Holarrhena antidysenterica 
 Neem ki chaal – Azadirachta indica 
 Sapatparan ki chaal – Asparagus racemosus 
 Sanuhi ka dudh – Euphorbia nerifolia 
 Giloy – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Amaltas – Cassia fistula 
 Karaj ke beej – Pongamia glabra 
 Nagarmotha – Cyperus rotundus 
 Khadir  – Acacia catechu 
 Peepal – Piper Longum 
 Bach – Acrous calamus 
 Malkangni – Celastrus paniculatus 
 Vatsanabha – Aconitum ferox 
 Kaduva taila (Mustard oil) 
 Gomutra 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients from number 1 to 32 up to 48 grams, Vatsanabha visha up to 96 grams and prepared kalka. 
 Now take kaduva taila up to 7 litres and gomutra up to 26 litres. 
 Mix all the ingredients in a container and cook to prepared taila. 
 On completion, strain the liquid and store it. 

 Usage 
 This is for external use, take the oil and apply on affected area.

Mahamarichyadi Taila (Oil) 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 17 edition, 661-662. 
 Introduction 
 Mahamarichyadi Taila (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation. This is formulated from the mixture of many herbs. This formulation is known to contain properties like antifungal, antiseptic and antioxidant etc. This is usually used to treat problems related to skin. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Nishoth – Operculina Turpethum 
 Dantimool – Baliospermum montanum’s root

 Khadir  – Acacia catechu 
 Peepal – Piper Longum 
 Bach – Acrous calamus 
 Malkangni – Celastrus paniculatus

 Kaduva taila (Mustard oil)

 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients from number 1 to 32 up to 48 grams, Vatsanabha visha up to 96 grams and prepared kalka. 
 Now take kaduva taila up to 7 litres and gomutra up to 26 litres. 
 Mix all the ingredients in a container and cook to prepared taila. 
 On completion, strain the liquid and store it. 
 
 Usage 
 This is for external use, take the oil and apply on affected area. 
 Indications 
 
 Leprosy 
 Psoriasis 
 Eczema 
 Leucoderma 
 Itching 
 Acne 
 Ulcers 
 Septic wounds 
 Ringworm 
 Scabies 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the formulation under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
